document:
Set a time limit for decisions on EUSS applications., EUSS is Discriminatory on EU Family without Application Decision Time Limit.

UK government should give a time limit on the application process for EUSS / EUSS Family Permit., Like myself, many EU family have been separated because of this no time limit for making decision on the applications.

Unlike other visa application which has decision time limits, the EUSS Family Permit stated "as soon as possible" this gave the Home Office to interpret the "as soon as possible" to take for ever.

"as soon as possible" can be a year, two years or three years in the eyes on the Home Office decision makers as there is no time limit for "as soon as possible".

We want time limit.

Make Skilled Workers eligible for permanent residence after 3 years, The UK needs skilled workers. It is also right that skilled workers develop roots in Britain before they are allowed to live here permanently. However, people in the UK on Skilled Worker visas should be eligible to apply for Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR) after three years, not the current five., As the UK aims to attract skilled workers, it should lower the time necessary to attain permanent residence (ILR) to 3 years. This should make us more competitive in the global skilled workers market where nations like Australia and Canada offer permanent residence on arrival to people with the right skills.
 
Immigrants should have deep links to the country before they are given ILR. So I am not calling on the Government to give permanent residence visas on arrival but after 3 years of residence.

Require a negative covid-19 tests before flights into or out of England, Flights involve lots of people in a confined space, so we believe the Government should require everyone taking a flight into or out of England to have a recent negative covid-19 test, irrespective of the entry requirements of the country a person is travelling to.,

Make legal aid available to all parents seeking access to children, Bring back legal aid in family courts to help prevent parents being denied access to their children unfairly. shouldn't be used as weapons or as a means of control other the other parent., Parents on low incomes or benefits cannot get the legal representation they need to make sure they can access their children when it is in their best interest.

Do more to prevent deer fatalities on the roads through Cannock Chase (AONB), More needs to be done in Staffordshire to prevent deer fatalities, such as:
- Reducing the speed limits from 60mph to 30 or 40mph
- Fencing the forest from the road 
- Creating deer crossing bridges
- Floodlighting the area, to enable drivers to see clearly
- Speed cameras, Recently, the incidents of deer collisions have increased enormously, on roads such as the A513, A460, and others. More needs to be done in Staffordshire to prevent this from happening. The A513 between Milford and Rugeley currently has a speed limit of 60 miles per hour. When a deer or other animal tries to cross the road, stopping the vehicle in time is impossible - especially in the dark. 
The amount of dead and injured deer on the A513 alone is astonishing - it's near enough every day now.

Pledge any necessary military support to defend Ukraine, We find the threat of economic sanctions to be utterly insufficient to deter Russia and want the Government to pledge to defend Ukraine, up to and including full-scale military intervention if required., The United Kingdom has a centuries-old, time-honoured tradition of opposing tyranny; dating back to the Napoleonic wars and even Magna Carta. Our history is full of examples of the government and the people choosing the difficult path in order to combat slavers, despots, and other infringers on human rights. We should seek, we believe, to live up to the example our predecessors set. In doing so, we should hold to the spirit of the Budapest memorandum and guarantee the sovereignty of Ukraine.

Make it a legal requirement for all drivers to carry their licence when driving, To amend the Road Traffic Act 1988 and make it a legal requirement for all drivers to be in possession of their licence when driving and for it to be an offence not to produce it to police officers at the time of being pulled over., Currently carrying a licence is optional and if a police officer wants to check the licence of the driver, and they do not have it on them, they have to show their licence at the station within 7 days.
 
This can make it easier for offenders to give false details to officers regarding their entitlement to drive, and then not showing up to produce their licence.
 
It is time to update the laws.

Backdate settled status from beginning of application, If someone applies for settled status & after a long delay receives it, make it valid - at least for the purpose of applying for citizenship - from the date it was submitted, not when granted. This way the one year wait needed to apply for citizenship is not affected by the slow approval process., To make the process fair: then it is not dependant of the time it took to process the application which is understandably slow do to their sheer number, the pandemic, or whatever else. All who applied will be eligible to apply for citizenship.

Lift sanctions against Afghanistan to reduce barriers to humanitarian aid, The Government should lift all sanctions against Afghanistan, to make it easier for humanitarian aid to get into the country. It has been reported that current sanctions are creating a barrier to getting humanitarian aid to Afghanistan.,

Give tenants the right to terminate short term tenancies if repairs not made, The Government should give all tenants the right to terminate their short term tenancies if the landlord repeatedly ignores reasonable requests for repairs to be made. , This should apply regardless of whether the landlord has a rent guarantor in place or not to cover the shortfall in rent. Tenants should be able to vacate without a two months’ notice period provided their rent is up to date.

Grant amnesty for all asylum seekers waiting for more than 3 years, The Government should grant an amnesty to asylum seekers who have been in UK for more than three years, but limit their access to benefits other than for medical treatment., Granting this amnesty would allow these people to work legally and pay tax, helping the long list of new asylum seekers to be dealt with. This would also reduce the cost to taxpayers of their housing and other forms of support, and reduce the burden on the Home Office.

Increase the national speed limit to 80mph, Cars are more advanced nowadays. Most cars people commonly drive can exceed 80mph and have brakes to stop in an emergency. 10mph may not seem like a big change, but it could decrease travel time on dual carriageways and motorways by almost 14.3%.,

Automatically upgrade A2 motorcycle licence to A licence after 2 years, Now, that we have left the EU, to go back to previous law (pre-2013) whereby motorcycle licenses were automatically upgraded from an A2 licence to an unrestricted licence after two years. Riders should have learned the necessary skill in these two years to ride bigger bikes., We believe taking the same Mod1/Mod2 tests a second time, just on a different capacity bike, doesn't make any difference to training or safety standards.
 
In the past, an A2 rider would be restricted to two years before achieving a full unrestricted motorcycle license. I propose we now return to that scheme again.

Remove travel restrictions during visa processing for UK based applicants., Allow people awaiting a decision on their UK settlement visa to travel abroad and return as and when needed., Applicants are waiting upwards of 6 months to get a decision on their visa. Unless they are able to pay an additional £800 for an expedited response, they could lose their fees and immigration status if they have to travel. The home office is making an 800% profit on some applications and individuals are paying thousands of pounds for slow, inefficient service.  The financial, emotional and physical effects of these restrictions can be devastating.

Ease visa rules for the first-degree relatives of British nationals in Ukraine, First-degree relatives of British nationals (to incl. spouses and children of the first-degree relative) applying for a Standard Visitor visa must be exempted from application fees and processed in a priority order similarly to those who applied through U.K.’s family migration route., To protect and support the family members of British nationals amidst Russian aggression and war against Ukraine.

Ban all sporting matches against Russia until Putin gets his troops out, Legislate that no UK teams play against Russian teams either international or individual either on Russian soil or anywhere in the world until Russia withdraws from all land seized in Crimea, or Donetsk since 2013, These will certainly be used for propoganda purposes and could pose danger to those from UK visiting or taking part

Get Russian money out of our Politics! Hand Russian cash to Ukrainian charities, Compel any UK political party that has taken donations since 2014 from any Russian or Belarussian business or person, or from any other source with ties to those regimes, to pay the full amount of said donations to charities supporting Ukrainian victims of Russian aggression in Ukraine and the UK, Since 2014, Russia has illegally occupied Ukraine. In light of recent escalation of aggression, our political system must be and be seen to be free of any and all Russian influence, but we cannot simply return dirty money to a corrupt regime. It is fitting and appropriate for such money to directly benefit victims of Russian aggression.

Change the units used in road transport from imperial to metric, Change national speed limits to kilometres per hour, change all road signage to kilometres from miles and from yards to metres. This will bring the UK in line with most of the rest of the world in using metric units., Standardising units in line with other local countries will help reduce confusion for visitors to the UK. UK exceptionalism does not help with road safety.

Offer fast track asylum to any Ukrainians displaced due to the invasion, The Government should create a process to admit any Ukrainians displaced due to the Russian invasion, which operates under the presumption of granting asylum and can be applied for outside the UK., The threat from the Russian invasion of Ukraine is extremely high and has the potential to displace huge numbers. The morally correct thing is to admit as many refugees from this conflict as possible without leaving them in limbo, shirking our responsibilities or forcing them to undertake a dangerous journey to apply.

Allow Ukrainians with family in the UK to enter the UK without a visa, Allow Ukrainians citizens to join their family in the UK and cross the border without the UK visa if they can prove they have relatives in the UK., Ukrainian citizens' lives are under threat due to the violent aggression of Russia.

Seize assets held by anyone with close ties to the Russian government, Pass laws to seize assets belonging to anyone with close ties to the Russian government and sell said assets to help fund our NHS and local authorities., We believe current sanctions are inadequate at preventing states from behaving in negative ways. Directly removing assets with no compensation will hurt them far more.

Accept Ukrainian Asylum seekers and refugees escaping Russian aggression., Create an immediate refugee scheme that permits UK hosts, references and or guarantors to vet and vouch for Ukrainian citizens escaping the violence., This is an unprecedented act of war against a sovereign nation. As the UK government, G7 and NATO have failed to protect the soverign integrity of Ukraine it must now do all it can do protect the people. I like many other UK citizens have friends in the Ukraine who I wish to offer my home to.

Place the strictest possible sanctions on Russia until it withdraws from Ukraine, Some proposed sanctions on Ukraine could hurt UK citizens, most obviously by raising energy costs and restricting supply. As citizens of the UK, we are are prepared to pay this price. These would be minor problems compared to the suffering of the Ukrainian people., Place as many strong unilateral sanctions as possible on Russia until it withdraws from Ukraine.

Encourage our international partners to do the same.

Draw up and implement a specific Ukrainian refugee strategy for the UK, The Government should draw up and share with Parliament and the public a specific strategy for accepting Ukrainian refugees into the UK who are seeking to avoid the present conflict. The strategy should include objectives, process and timing and assign responsibility within the Cabinet., Many will be familiar with the Kindertransport efforts during the Second World War, which resulted in the rescue of thousands of children at risk in Nazi-occupied Europe. The present conflict in Ukraine has the potential to pose a similar threat to the most vulnerable. The Government, learning from that process in 1938 and onwards, draw up and share an actionable strategy for accepting refugees from Ukraine, as required.

Grant Ukrainian citizens fleeing the war full rights to live and work in the UK, The Government should extend rights to reside in the UK, with rights to work and access public services, to any Ukrainian citizen fleeing the war.
 
The Government should also encourage other European countries to offer similar rights., Fighting the Russians directly could start World War 3. However if the UK and other European countries give safe haven to those poor souls who are about to lose everything, we can show that Europe stands together, and we are not afraid of bullies, no matter how large their army or how horrific their weapons.

Seek to impose a no-fly zone over Ukraine, The Government should work with international partners to seek to impose a no-fly zone over Ukraine, in order to try and stop Russian aircraft from flying over Ukraine.,

Stop borris & government from getting involved with the Russia/Ukrainian attack., stay out of the conflict with Russi, attacking  Ukrainian soil, we want absolutely no involvement with putin and his plans. We want the government, parliament and borris to stay out of it this is not what the people want this is a bad choice from boris that no one wants involvement in., Absolutely avoid any conflict and involvement with putins attack on Ukrainians. To actually care about the peoples choice and rights. We like life we want to live not go to an un necessary war

Keep Covid Tests Free for Everyone, Keep COVID-19 tests free and readily available for everyone.

We believe there is no public health justification for ending the availability of free covid tests during the pandemic., UK residents and visitors have a right to know if they are infected with covid19 and likely to pass on a potentially deadly virus to others. This ability should not be dependant on ability to pay for tests.

We demand that free covid tests continue to be made readily available at least until the covid-19 pandemic is declared over.

Full embargo of Russian imports in lieu of active military support in Ukraine, Impose a full embargo on Russian goods including gold, platinum, refined petroleum, gas, fertilizer and all other vital raw materials and resources that Russia's economy is built upon. If NATO forces will not support Ukraine through military action, then peaceful, economic action must be taken., We think the sanctions against Russia, Putin and his regime were inadequate in 2014 after Putin's annexation of Crimea. If NATO forces will not support Ukraine through military action, then sever all economic ties with Russia. Sanctioning a few oligarchs is not enough.

Allow Ukrainian citizens with family in the UK to enter the UK without a visa., Currently Ukrainian citizens need a visa for any type of entry to the UK. UK embassies are now closed in Kiev which means Ukrainian people who have relatives living in the UK cannot be reunited with their loved ones. Remove visa requirements so that families can be reunited and safe.,

Ban Russia from using SWIFT banking now!, We want the government to ban Russia from using the SWIFT banking system now and not later., Putin's unprovoked and cold blooded attack of a sovereign, democratic nation warrants this and further sanctions. We cannot believe that Putin will stop at Ukraine unless maximum pressure and pain is brought against his regime, even if it means we must shoulder some of that pain ourselves.

Give Ukrainians right to reside in the UK, Let Ukrainians and people fleeing Ukraine, regardless of nationality, have right to reside in the UK., This morning (24/02/22) Russia invaded Ukraine. Many people will be fleeing Ukraine, we should let them live in the UK. Rather than send more people with weapons to their country we should share our space with them.

Waive visa requirement for Ukrainian refugees., Join other nations in providing a route to safety for refugees. Waive all visa requirements for Ukrainian passport holders arriving in the UK., They are war refugees, our hands are tied to assist with boots on the ground, let us give the people of Ukraine a safe place for their families and children to flee to.

Seize Russian oligarch properties within the UK, Seize Russian properties/assets in response to the Russian invasion of Ukraine., Russia and it's elite need to see further consequences for these actions.

Create a no fly zone over Ukraine., Ukrainians are fighting for their lives with very little support or heavy weaponry. 
The west has said it will support Ukraine as best it can and with this action Ukraine would have a better chance of defending itself., You promised you’d help the people of Ukraine. 
This is what they are asking for..this is what they need.

The UK government to accept and help Ukrainian Refugees, We want the government to not only place sanctions on Russia but to also help Ukrainian refugees fleeing from the conflict, providing them with housing, support, resources and jobs.
Right now we should be doing what we can to help support those in need and fleeing this awful war., At the end of the day it’s about being decent human beings, we’re the fifth largest economy in the world, and if the UK is going to place sanctions on Russia, it should also be helping the Ukrainian people too and those that are fleeing the conflict.
No body in the 21st century wants a war, but most of all the Ukrainian people don’t want a war, and if the government really wants to help, it can start by helping the people affected.

Commit to providing refuge for at least 100,000 Ukrainian women & children., The Government should publicly announce they will welcome 100,000 Ukrainian woman & children fleeing the war zone. Government bodies should work together to provide support and set up a scheme where UK citizens can offer to welcome a Ukrainian family., Since the invasion of Ukraine by Russia, 100,000’s women & children are living in a war zone and trying to flee for safety. It is our right as democratic and free nation to provide safety for those fleeing a war zone. We need to show Ukrainians that we are open and ready to welcome them.

Help Ukrainian refugees and create a safe path for them to get to the UK, There are many people from Ukraine fleeing from the war with children that are in grave danger. We as a wealthy country should help get them to the UK where we can provide them with a safe place and protect them from the war., I know many Ukrainian people, I have seen them on social media begging to be helped. Many of them have taken refuge in Romanian and Moldova. However they don’t have as many resources as we do. We need to help them. Please! I’m begging.

The UK government must urgently help Ukrainians who need sanctuary, Britons have been appalled by the actions of Putin's Russia in invading Ukraine and the impact this will cause on their totally innocent population. 

The UK government should establish a well-resourced initiative working with councils across the country, to welcome Ukrainians who need sanctuary., A refugee initiative for Ukraine is absolutely vital. 

Leading humanitarian charities including the International Rescue Committee UK, the Refugee Council and many others said the Ukraine attack could be "the most significant European conflict since the collapse of Yugoslavia".

They point out "a generation ago, the UK saved the lives of thousands of families from the Balkans through an evacuation and resettlement programme". It is time for the UK to step up again to support Ukrainians.

Pledge humanitarian aid to support Ukraine and its citizens, On February 24th, Russia invaded Ukraine under the premise of 'liberating' Eastern regions.

Economic sanctions are not enough. I pledge the Government to put together a humanitarian aid package to support the Ukrainian people affected by the invasion., Ukraine is on the brink of a humanitarian crisis. Waking up at 5 am to the sound of missile strikes and air-raid sirens.

Heartbreaking pictures surfaced of Ukrainian families displaced and taking shelter in overcrowded metro stations akin to photos from London Underground in 1940.

Services, food, and medical supplies are at risk. It's only a matter of time Ukraine will need our support. We don't know Russia's intentions and the length of the invasion.

We must take action to help now.

Do not send any UK military to Ukraine, and send aid only, We do not want the United Kigdom to send Army, Navy, or Air Force into the Ukraine to support them in the current crisis with Russia. This is to prevent an attack from Russia, which would be devastating for the United Kindom and its people., As a country, we should send only humanitarian aid. Food, medical supplies, clothing, and essentials to help the Ukrainian people.
We would also request that the UK does not send Army, Navy, or Air Force to Russia, which could be perceived as provocative for the protection of British people.

Lift visa requirements for Ukrainians while the conflict continues, Ukrainians fleeing the country still need to obtain a visa to enter the UK. This is an impossible task as the consulates are closed. The UK parliament should temporarily lift visa requirements for Ukrainians so they can seek shelter in the country., Currently, Ukrainians fleeing the country still need to obtain a visa to enter the UK. This is an impossible task as the consulates are closed, meaning that even family members and friends of British citizens from Ukraine can't come to visit them at this hour of need. The UK parliament should temporarily lift visa requirements for Ukrainians so they can seek shelter in the country. This act will help the civilian population much more than any words of comfort, hopes or prayers.
Total embargo of the Russian Federation., Apply a total embargo on all goods and services between this country and Russia,  until Russia pulls its troops out of Ukraine.,

Allow Ukrainian residents UK visa rights., The UK has stopped accepting visa applications from Ukrainians, which has denied them safe passage to The UK. We should support Ukraine in it's struggle against Russian invasion in every way possible, including allowing fleeing residents to seek asylum in The UK.,

UK government to allow Ukrainian refugees a safe route to the UK for asylum., Please reconsider the nationality and borders bill criminalising those trying to arrive in the UK illegally and for those who facilitate illegal entry into the country- penalising those seeking sanctuary. Please un-suspend applications from Ukraine for people who are not related to British nationals, There is currently no legal route for Ukraine nationals without family in the UK to seek asylum. We need to do more to help the estimated 5 million displaced people reach safety.

Ban all UK trade with Russia and Belarus until Russian troops leave Ukraine, We want the Government to prohibit trade with Russia and Belarus. This action must be undertaken with the utmost urgency due to the current military invasion of Ukraine and the impending catastrophic loss of life., Having ruled out military action in support of Ukraine, governments are relying on economic pressure on the Russian regime.  We believe that only action which brings about maximum economic isolation will be effective in forcing the Russian regime to restrict its attemps to destroy Ukraine as an independent country.

Lift visa requirements between Ukraine and UK, Implement emergency measure to support the swift exit of both Ukrainian family members of UK citizens and the family of Ukrainian people resident in UK., To save the lives of the Ukrainian family members of UK citizens. UK must play its part in supporting those affected

Urge the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe to expel Russia, The UK Government should use its influence in the OSCE Permanent Council and Parliamentary Assembly to seek the expulsion of Russia from the organisation., On 24 February 2022, Russia launched a massive military attack against Ukraine. In doing so, Russia has shown complete disregard for the Helsinki Act (1975) and its Declaration on Principles Guiding Relations between Participating States. 

Crucially, Russia has abandoned key OSCE principles of: I. Sovereign equality, respect for the rights inherent in sovereignty; II. Refraining from the threat or use of force; III. Inviolability of frontiers.

Enable safe passage into the UK for Ukrainian citizens, Five million people could be displaced from Ukraine in light of the Russian invasion in February 2022. The British Government are currently only accepting visas from Ukrainians with close relatives who are British., Dozens of charities including the International Rescue Committee UK, the Refugee Council, Save The Children, and Amnesty International have all expressed concerns and have pleaded for the British Home Office to do more. 

We call on the British Government to facilitate safe passage to Britain for Ukrainian civilians, regardless of relationships.

Provide a safe route for any Ukranian citizen to claim asylum, The home office must allow any Ukranian citizen who wishes it to claim asylum in the UK. There must be a safe legal route which is easy for Ukranian citizens to follow, Basic human decency argues that this is something we must do. Any help that the people of Ukraine need, we should offer.

Provide visas for Ukrainian citizens fleeing ongoing conflict, We are deeply shocked and saddened at the news that visa applications for Ukrainian citizens are now being rejected. We ask that visas for any and all Ukrainian citizens be processed without delay, enabling those who can flee the ongoing conflict., We have a moral duty to do what is right, humane, and to safeguard the lives of our fellow Europeans. The Government of the UK is charged with enacting this humanitarian responsibility on behalf of the people. 

We urge you in the strongest terms to offer a legal and safe way for Ukrainians facing the worst European crisis in our lifetime to find sanctuary in our country. We stand behind the innocent people of Ukraine and demand an empathetic and humanitarian response.

Immediate lifting of visa requirements between Ukraine and United Kingdom, This will streamline and support the swift exit of the family members of people from Ukraine who are resident in the United Kingdom.
It will apply as an emergency measure to all Ukrainians traveling to United Kingdom., UK has to stand in solidarity with Ukraine and its people and will play part in assisting them in their time of need.
In order to condemn Russian invasion of Ukraine, and the unjustified and unprovoked attack against a democratic sovereign state in Europe, Ukrainians have a right to go to the UK because of the threat to be killed by Russian troops.

Create a fast-track visa for British-employed Ukrainians and their families, Establish a fast-track visa program for Ukrainians who are employed (whether full-time or under contract) by the British Government or British companies to apply for themselves and their families to come to the UK., We feel the British economy, in particular the tech industry, has benefited substantially from relatively low-cost, but very high quality, Ukrainian labour over the past two decades.

The many skilled Ukrainians who contribute so much to our economy should receive special treatment in their hour of need.

The British economy stands to benefit enormously from the skilled labour that Britain would attract with this initiative.

Go further with sanctions against Russia. Hold nothing back for 'later'., To impose more sanctions on Russia even if to do so would mean an economic 'hit' for the UK. Do not hold anything back for later. There is no later for Ukraine. This is it. Do more to ensure other countries back 'evicting' Russia from SWIFT banking system. Include energy arrangements in sanctions., We hand out investment visas to many more Russians including those who have strong links to the Russian government. They invade Ukraine. We put tiny sanctions in place saying we need to hold something back in case they go into the rest of Ukraine. Now they have begun a full scale invasion and we are still holding back. Once this happens, that's it for Ukraine. No more freedom. And it won't end there with Russia.

Provide sanctuary to refugees from Ukraine, This petition calls to allow visa free travel into the U.K. to Ukrainian refugees fleeing military invasion of their country. We should open up our borders and provide safe haven to these innocent people., I want the Government to help innocent people fleeing war in the middle of Europe.

Create a system to house Ukrainian families with children in the UK, Put into place a simple system in which Ukrainian families with children can apply to enter the United Kingdom via a neighbouring nation such as Poland and be sponsored to stay at a DBS-checked family home within our country during this immediate disgraceful act of aggression., Being a veteran of our British Army and the space and willingness I will do whatever I need to do to provide safety for children who are now in conflict within Europe. I think this is the least we can do to help the innocent Ukrainian people.

Grant Ukrainians, who have over-stayed their visas, leave to remain, Grant Ukrainians, who have over-stayed their visas in the UK, leave to remain until it’s safe for them to return to Ukraine., Russian invasion of Ukraine makes it unsafe for people to return. Some Ukrainians were anticipating the war in their homeland and chose to stay in the UK after their visas have expired. We have a duty to protect them until it’s safe for them to return.

Create a Government fund that accepts public donations to support Ukraine, We would like the Government to create a dedicated fund, with an accessible system for the public to make donations, to provide financial support to Ukraine for military defence, refugee evacuation, medical supplies, and essential food and water. , The UK should do whatever it can to support Ukraine to have the freedoms they deserve. Through small donations from UK Citizens we can help Ukraine through this conflict. All donations should go directly to support Ukraine.

Seek to negotiate peace in Ukraine without sanctions or military action, We want the Government to try and negotiate an immediate ceasefire in Ukraine, and facilitate peace talks, without the use of sanctions or military force., Military intervention by the UK or by Western allies in Ukraine could cause the war to escalate killing thousands or millions of people in Ukraine and in other countries.
 
Sanctions will affect civilians, in Russia and in the UK, who have nothing to do with this conflict.
 
War is never the solution. All the efforts of the UK Government should go towards negotiating a peaceful solution in the interest of the Ukrainian and of the British people.

The UK should allow refugees from Ukraine to come to the country immediately, During the exceptional circumstances unfolding.  The UK should bypass the strict immigration requirements for those fleeing the conflict in the Ukraine, These are exceptional times for our near neighbours in Europe.  We should be considering all options to support these people in these desperate circumstances

Wave visa entry restrictions for Ukrainians during the current conflict, Allow visa-free entry to the UK for Ukrainians fleeing the conflict with Russia., It is our ethical duty to support Ukrainians fleeing the conflict with Russia by providing safe harbour in the UK for Ukrainian refugees.

Allow Ukrainian citizens British refuge and temporarily make entry visa free, Visa consessions for Ukrainian citizens do not go far enough. The UK can introduce visa free travel to unite Ukraine families already in the UK, offer a place of refuge for families. Today the UK requires a visa for Ukraine citizens, now almost impossible to obtain without infrastructure due to war., Britain has always supported displaced families and offered refuge to those whose values reflect our own. Now it is time to do more. Temporarily allow visa free travel to UK from Ukraine.

Reopen all visa services for Ukrainians in Ukraine, Reopen visa applications for Ukrainian nationals in Ukraine (outside of the family migration scheme) .

Ukrainians fleeing oppression are currently unable to make visa applications in Ukraine to visit, work, study or join family in the UK., Allow a legal route for Ukrainians to seek aslyum in the UK.

Politicians and Parties should transfer their Russian donations to Ukraine., It is critical that any politician or political party who has accepted donations from individuals or organisations that have Russian origin must transfer these funds to the Democratic Government of Ukraine., To support the brave defenders of Ukraine from the fascist gangsterism of Putin.

Open safe, legal routes to the UK for people fleeing war in Ukraine., End the effective suspension of visa applications from Ukraine, urgently create a resettlement program in the U.K. and facilitate Ukrainians applying for asylum from third countries., This is to save lives of Ukrainians caught in a war of aggression by the Russian state.

Urgently suspend all entry visa requirements for Ukrainian nationals fleeing war, Escalation of humanitarian crisis in Ukraine means that thousands of families are seeking refuge in neighbouring countries. While most of them will remain there, some will have good reasons to travel further, including to the UK., The war in Ukraine is escalating hour by hour. This is widely reported. Families fleeing conflict in Ukraine have no way to apply for visa via usual route (apply in their own country) so urgent action is needed now to suspend usual entry requirements.

Send peacekeeping force into Western Ukraine, The people of Western Ukraine deserve our support so a peacekeeping force should be sent in, It’s terrible what’s happening in Ukraine now. They need our help

Waive immigration rules for those fleeing Ukraine, Ukraine, a peaceful sovereign nation, is under unprovoked attack. It is imperative that we do everything we can to help the people of Ukraine - whether they choose to stay or to leave. For the latter, we must remove any barrier to entry for Ukrainian refugees, immediately., Supporting Ukraine and yes people is a moral imperative. We cannot expect our European neighbours to lead on this alone. The UK must stand with our neighbours and allies.

Remove visa and passport requirements for Ukrainian refugees NOW, The Government need to drop the visa and passport requirements for Ukrainian refugees right now and allow them to seek safety and protection in our country., Ukraine is one of our European allies and is at its most vulnerable state since World War 2. We need to allow Ukrainians to take refuge in our country immediately to keep them safe and protected.

Establish a safe route into the UK for Ukrainian refugees, As Russia invades Ukraine, thousands of Ukraine citizens are fleeing the country into the West. The US predicts some 5 million might be displaced due to the conflict. 

Some of them will be headed to the UK due to family links. We must be a safe haven in these times of war., Against the backdrop of this conflict, the UK government has pledged its support to the people of Ukraine, lighting up Downing Street in Ukrainian colours, delivering public addresses to condemn Putin's actions, and threatening further sanctions.

At the same time, we have withdrawn all Visas to Ukraine's citizens. There is no longer a safe and legal route for these refugees.

Words are not enough, the UK government must take action and be a welcoming shelter to those in need.

Open UK border to Ukrainians fleeing the Russian invasion, Open our borders to Ukrainians feeling the Russian invasion regardless to whether or not they have family here in the U.K. We have a moral obligation to help those fleeing the war. Many of our neighbours have waived visa requirements in the face of the unfolding crisis. We should do the same.,

Waive visas and offer asylum for people fleeing the conflict in Ukraine, The UK Home office should waive visas and offer asylum for those fleeing the conflict in Ukraine. , The Home Office is flying Ukraine's flag while denying visas for refugees. At the same time, there are reports of British Citizens with Ukrainian partners and family unable to enter the UK for fear that their loved ones will be denied entry. 

According to YouGov, 6 in 10 Britons supports a scheme to resettle Ukrainian refugees in the UK. The Irish government has lifted all visa requirements between Ukraine and Ireland, and the UK government should do the same.

Re-open Visa applications to ALL citizens of Ukraine., The UK should open it’s borders to Ukrainian citizens, regardless of whether they have family or relatives here, and support them to seek safety in the UK.,

Immediately offer to host a Ukrainian government in exile, Whilst it seems inevitable that Ukraine will lose the current conventional war the conditions must be created in which it can continue to resist Russian aggression thereafter.  To do this a government in exile must be established in a friendly location.  The UK should be that friendly location., Permitting Russia in fact to prevail in Ukraine is unthinkable. There is no reason to believe that Ukraine is Putin’s only objective and (absent a coup d’état) it is likely to be years before any return to normal relations can be achieved.  The UK stands for nothing if we fail to stand up for liberal democratic values. Providing a safe location from which a Ukrainian resistance can be organised is the least that we can do and must be offered immediately.
Create a free path for Ukrainian refugees to the UK, Provide free access for Ukrainian refugees, There’s a war happening!
Let Ukrainians apply for political asylum without a visa!, let Ukrainians apply for political asylum without a visa, let Ukrainians apply for political asylum without a visa

Provide a safe haven to those fleeing from the conflict from Ukraine., Will the supportive rhetoric of our Government be backed up by its deeds?
