Allow individuals, charities, community groups and businesses to sponsor refugees and asylum seekers from any country to live in the UK., Globally we are seeing increasing numbers of refugees and asylum seekers - yet we have no fair, equal or concrete humanitarian assistance plan. People want to help - Lets harness that generosity by implementing a system that makes this lets people in the UK protect all refugees, and welcome refugees into our homes and workplaces to create a global family based on collaboration. Make it universal, to support all people forced to leave their homeland.

Seek to suspend Russia as a permanent member of the UN Security Council, With the invasion of Ukraine, Russia has shown that it is unfit to be a permanent member of the Security Council. We believe Russia has consistently breached the founding principles of the United Nations, and should be suspended from the Security Council with immediate effect., Having committed unprovoked acts of aggression with the invasion of a sovereign nation, and the apparent excessive use of force and targeting of civilians, these heinous acts perpetrated by Russia are incompatible with the privileged position it holds as as a permanent member of the Security Council.
 
We believe Russia has abused its position as a permanent member of the Security Council to avoid the consequences of its actions, and the time has come for Russia to feel the full force of international condemnation.

Make Ukraine War denial a criminal offence, We believe denying the Ukraine war is rooted in the same place as Holocaust denial and should be made a criminal offence in the UK, where people have easy access to independent media. Regretfully there are people outside Russia who still deny this war. This can’t be acceptable and tolerated., War in Ukraine denial negates the established facts of the current war of Russia against Ukraine. These views can perpetuate hateful beliefs that help the continuation of this war. The denial of this war undermines the truth, it's an important tool for the Putin regime and his propaganda. This lie is especially painful for the millions of Ukrainian people who are now refugees, who lost their livelihoods and whose families are being killed in this war.

Require all new motor vehicles be limited to a maximum speed of 80mph, The Government should take action on this important aspect of road safety and limit the maximum speed that new vehicles - except for emergency vehicles - can reach on the road to 80mph., The national speed limit is 70mph (112.7kph). There is no need or justification for vehicles made for use on the roads to be able to reach speeds in excess of 80mph (128.7kph). The impact of high speed collisions are often devastating. 

All new vehicles sold for use on the roads in the UK should be limited to 80mph, with exceptions for emergency services.
 
By reducing the speed vehicles can attain the roads should be safer. The average speed of collisions should be reduced. Drivers of stolen vehicles should be less able to outrun the police. The impact on emergency services and NHS treatment costs could be reduced.

Temporarily limit speed limits to 55mph to help reduce reliance on Russian oil, Introduce emergency legislation that reduces the speed limit for all 70mph and 60mph roads to 55mph. Make this time limited to the duration of the Russian invasion of Ukraine.

Back this with a public information campaign positioning this as a national act of solidarity for the people of Ukraine., This will send a strong signal and could have a material impact on UK imports of Russian oil, which amount to 8% of our our oil demand; if we reduce demand enough we could in theory remove any need for Russian imports.
 
This could reduce inflows to the Russian economy, put pressure on Vladimir Putin and reduce Russia's economic ability to wage war.

Encourage global ban on Russian oil and gas, and full ban from SWIFT, Put pressure on all relevant governments and parties to end imports of Russian oil and gas, ban all Swift transactions with Russia, to put pressure on Russia to end the invasion of Ukraine.,

Change the spouse visa eligibility requirements and application process, Spouse Visas should be:
1. Free
2. Available to apply for within the UK
3. Not subject to financial requirements
4. Processed within 60 working days., The current Spouse Visa application process is separating families, causing financial burdens and creating uncertainty. This is adversely affecting a lot of UK citizens, both emotionally and financially. Having a family is a human right, not a privilege.
 
Prior to Brexit, EU citizens were able to move to the UK to reside with their spouse without having to pay any fees, apply outside of the UK or meet any financial requirement.

Fund free air travel to the UK for Ukrainian refugees, More than 3 million people (mainly women and children) have fled Ukraine to neighbouring and other countries, many with nothing but the clothes on their back. Those who receive permission to come to the UK should be able to fly to the UK for free. The Government should pay to fund this., At the start of March, one airline announced support for Ukrainian refugees by providing free seats from neighbouring countries. It is important the Government takes action to make sure any Ukrainian refugee who has received permission to come to the UK has access to free air travel.

Keep sanctions until Russia has fully compensated Ukraine, The UK government in conjunction with their allies must insist that the Russian Federation rebuilds the entire Ukraine infrastructure up to the last brick before ending any of the strict sanctions that have been imposed up to and after 21/03/2022, Russia must take full responsibility for its actions and pay for the total rebuild of Ukraine after Putin's illegal war. This needs to serve as a precedent for any country that aims to invade a sovereign nation. Russia cannot walk away from this illegal war without paying the price for destroying a nation. The sanctions need to remain in place for the decades that it will take to rebuild Ukraine.

Take action to increase driving test availability and enable faster resits, The Government must take action to increase driving test availability and enable faster resits. This should include additional funding to increase the number of slots available, and remove the rule requiring people to book resits at least 10 days away., Too many people are struggling to book their driving test, and it is unfair to make people wait at least 10 days to resit their test, if they fail.

Make anyone lawfully resident in the UK for five years eligible for ILR, We want the Government to extend eligibility to Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR) to anyone who has been lawfully resident in the UK for five years. Currently only certain visas give people rights to apply for ILR after five years, with many immigrants having to wait for 10 years., Immigrants with temporary leave to remain contribute to the UK economy. Only certain people can apply for ILR after five years, others might wait for 10 years to apply under the 'long residence' route.
 
We want anyone lawfully resident in the UK for five years to be eligible for ILR. This will save many immigrants the cost of further visa renewals, and give them security.

Open an Emergency Advisory & Operational Department to process Homes for Ukraine, I ask you to create an emergency Steering-Committee & Operational Department to help volunteers, charities & local authorities to coordinate the delivery of the “Homes for Ukraine” Scheme. Official government effort is required to process Ukrainian participants and to help them match with UK hosts, It is irresponsible of the government to suggest that the British public “find their own refugee”; the scheme is difficult & confusing to actualise. 
A civilian effort to assist UK host families to find Ukrainian refugees is under way; as volunteers we are overwhelmed by the sheer numbers of people who need assistance, particularly when processing the confusing Visa Applications. We need Government assistance to safeguarding & vet, in order to achieve the aim of inviting Ukrainians to the UK

Give Ukraine Weapon to Defend Their Sky: Help Ukraine save World from Extinction, Ukraine’s now fighting for the whole WORLD – for our freedom and independence. This attack on the whole nation and imminent threat to the whole world must be stopped immediately and the best air defence systems must be given to Ukraine to save lives and prevent devastating destructions., Ukrainians fight fearlessly and heroically, but all their heroism is wiped off by heavy bombardment and shelling taking thousands of innocent lives and destroying hundreds of homes daily. Realise that no one, no matter how brave they are, can fight against bombs and missiles unless they have proper Air Defence weapon.
Now we have UNIQUE opportunity to win the war and save the world due to brave Ukrainian people – give Ukraine the most advanced Air Defence weapon to defend their sky – Military aircrafts, S-400 – save OUR lives and give humanity chance to Survive.  
Do this TODAY – until it’s too late.

Enable Ukrainian children without passports to enter UK without attending a VAC, Any Ukrainians without passports need to attend a Visa Application Centre appointment before arriving in the UK.  Scrap the need for children to do this if their parent holds a passport.

Children are not a security risk.  Biometrics could easily be taken after arrival in the UK., The current requirement involves a significant extra journey for many families, the need to find accommodation near the VAC, extra uncertainty, and an additional step in the lengthy and complicated application process.

The UK is creating an unnecessary extra hurdle for traumatised and vulnerable families who could be welcomed more quickly and simply under the 'Homes for Ukraine' scheme.

Grant all Ukrainians living in the UK for 5 years Indefinite Leave to Remain, Due to the current situation in Ukraine, the Government should make all Ukrainians who have been living legally in the UK for the past 5 years eligible for Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR)., Currently non-UK nationals, including Ukrainians, are only eligible for ILR after 5 years of continuous living in the UK only in limited circumstances (such as, if they have spent 5 years on a work visa or 5 years on a marriage visa).
 
However, time spent on certain visas, such as student or intra-company transfer visas, doesn’t count. In that case a Ukrainian would have to spend 10 years in the UK before they are allowed to apply.

Grant family visa status to Ukrainian seasonal workers, Ukrainian seasonal workers have had their visas extended, but they are not allowed to change their jobs, bring their family over or claim other assistance. They are therefore open to possible exploitation. The government needs to grant family visa status to Ukraine seasonal workers.,

Min. 10-year sanctions on Russia if chemical/biological weapons used in Ukraine, We want the Government to commit to keeping current and future sanctions on Russia in place for at least 10 years, if they make use of any chemical or biological weapons in Ukraine. The Government should also urge other nations to make similar commitments., Commitments to long-term sanctions should make clear to Russia the consequences of deploying chemical or biological weapons in Ukraine.

Reform UK passport application tracking and options to fast-track applications, We want the Government to:
1. Improve passport tracking information so accurate, detailed and real-time information is available online for all passport applications.
2. Allow the option to fast-track any passport application (for a fee) for any reason.
, My recent experience of passport renewals has highlighted the need for the passport application system, and the tracking information provided to customers throughout the application process, to be overhauled.

There is a lack of communication in the system, which can cause a lot of stress. In addition, there is a lack of flexibility in the system for existing applications.

Waive all visa requirements for Ukrainian nationals and their dependents, The current visa application process required of refugees fleeing war in Ukraine is not fit for purpose and causing harm through its complexity, extreme delay and paucity of information to people who deserve our instant and unqualified protection. It is also damaging the UK's reputation., 150,000 British people have registered under the Homes for Ukraine scheme & 28,000 Ukrainian refugees have applied, yet only 2,700 visas have been granted and a fraction of those have arrived in the UK. This is in stark contrast to European countries where very many thousands have been welcomed since the outbreak of war. The visa system is grossly inadequate and harmful in its complexity and its huge delays. It is extremely embarrassing to British people, the vast majority of whom want to help.

Impose sanctions on Qatar in light of human rights concerns, Impose sanctions on Qatar due to the recent human rights issues, including those surrounding the 2022 Football World Cup., The recent events of the 2022 Qatar football world cup have highlighted clear human rights issues in the country of Qatar, which we believe violate articles 3-5 of the universal declaration of human rights.

Suspend Section 25 of the Landlord and Tenant Act (Grounds C to G), The Government has said it will review the Landlord and Tenant Act., Section 25 of the Act can be exploited by Landlords, allowing them to expropriate the investment the Tenant has made into the premises, including any goodwill developed over many years.
 
We are calling for a suspension of Section 25 (Grounds C to G), so that tenants cannot be evicted until a Government review has been concluded, and any reforms implemented.

Make using "Z" to show support for the invasion of Ukraine a criminal offence, We ask for the Government to make it a criminal offence to use the letter "Z" to indicate support for the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Since Russia invaded Ukraine on 24 of February 2022, the so called "zvastika" has been used to indicate support for it., People of the UK shall not be subjected to Russian fascist propaganda. Using "Z" to support the Russian invasion of Ukraine should be made a criminal offence, so that people doing this can be prosecuted.

Make a public support of Russian aggression in Ukraine a criminal offence, To criminalise a public support of Russia, Putin as well as using a symbols of Russian aggression in Ukraine in support(letter Z, georgian ribbon, etc.), After what Russians Army done and keep doing in Ukraine, especially to civilians, public support of Russia and using Russians symbols of this war must be criminalised.

Grant Ukrainian passport holders a 3 year unrestricted visa at the UK border., Allow Ukrainian passport holders a 3 year unrestricted visa at the UK border. No further checks needed, no local authority checks for the Ukrainian family scheme. , The Ukrainian family scheme is a disgrace. It is a failure of moral courage and the government is hiding behind bureaucracy to limit helping those in need. Or do they want to help but are incompetent?

Ukrainians are fleeing war and a murderous regime and the UK is reacting with paperwork. We should be open to refugees in their hour of need and the government has failed two of the most important tests of life: moral courage in helping others and basic competance.

Fund pay rise for police officers in line with inflation, plus 1%, The Government should fund a pay rise for police officers in line with inflation plus 1% for a minimum of 5 years. Police officer pay needs a huge hike as it has dramatically falls 20% behind the cost of living over the past decade, according to the Metropolitan Police Federation., The morale of many officers is lower than ever, as pressures and burn out increase. As the demand for officers increases, so does the workload. Too many officers are suffering financially. How does this Government expect police officers to carry out fair and honest policing while they are suffering financial strain and massive losses due to the constant attacks on policing and police pay? Stresses are building up and many police officers are leaving policing because they can’t afford it, and can’t afford to live.

Support Homes for Ukraine hosts to accommodate Ukraine Family Visa holders, The Government should permit and facilitate the matching of holders of Ukraine Family visas with hosts from the Homes for Ukraine (HfU) scheme, as this is not currently possible. Instead of having “homeless" status, they will get the 6+ month rent free benefit available under the HfU scheme., Ukrainian family members are eligible to join their relatives in the UK but the government does not provide an accommodation solution. Their UK-based relatives may not have enough space and private accommodation is unaffordable. The only remaining option is to apply for 'homeless’ status on arrival, which is deterring many from travelling. The joined up and fair solution is to allow and facilitate access for these individuals to the HfU scheme – providing 6+ months rent-free accommodation.

Stop the government's 'one way ticket' plan to send asylum seekers to Rwanda, The Government's latest plan is immoral and ignores serious human rights concerns about Rwanda. The Government needs to show leadership and work more closely with the French authorities and the EU to allow traumatised refugees to be processed with safety and dignity before they cross the Channel., This is a lazy and inappropriate solution to a complex problem and the Government should focus more on working with international partners to deal with the causes of asylum seeking. The Government should consider the long term damage this could do to the UKs reputation as a decent and compassionate society.

Stop the government from sending migrants to Rwanda #StoptheShip, The Prime Minister has unveiled plans to send ‘illegal migrants’ who reach Britain to Rwanda. 

We need to stop the government from doing this immediately. Parliament must pass a bill forbidding this!, ‘PM has announced the plans in a speech today. It has long been the government’s ambition to ‘offshore’ migrants. Other countries previously refused, but UK has made a deal with Rwanda.’
- Credit: UK Fact Check Politics

We need parliament to restrain the government from this heinous, inhumane and frightening new process which would endanger many and have far reaching consequences for decades to come.

Make Graduate visa extendable and count towards permanent residency, The Government should allow the newly introduced Graduate visa to be extendable and for holders of this visa to become eligible for permanent residency after 5 years., International applicants are denied the opportunity to engage in a fair application process simply because they possess a Graduate visa (also known as a post-study work visa) and not a British passport, EU settlement scheme or an Indefinite leave to remain.

Graduate visas are not free - they are paid for after meeting specified requirements to enable eligibility such as successful completion of an academic programme. However, international applicants are being rejected and not even afforded the chance to show their suitability for graduate roles solely because they possess this visa, as some organisations apparently uses the right to work documents as a criteria for disqualification, regardless of them having sponsorship rights.

Drop plans to send refugees to Rwanda, The government have announced plans to send refugees, who have a right under international law to claim asylum in the UK, to Rwanda to claim asylum there. This contravenes our international obligations and is inhumane. The government should drop these plans.,

Stop the deportation of asylum seekers (and 'migrants') to Rwanda., Rwanda, under President Kagame, has come under significant criticism for human rights abuses. It's record on asylum seekers is poor, The scheme will cost billions and be ineffective. It's a unrealistic, expensive and inhumane option., Parliament should prevent this wrong-headed and cruel scheme from going ahead, and call on the Government to develop legal means for asylum seekers to come to this country as a matter of urgency.

Reduce the speed limit of Newcastle Road, Hough from 40mph to 30mph, The speed limit as it stands through the village of Hough is 40mph, we would like it reduced to 30mph as we have some very bad bends and junctions on them. We are a built up residential area. We have no public crossing in the Hough., We would want the government/parliament to consider our petition as we have already had pets killed on the road, and we want change as somebody will be killed. We have a lot of elderly and children in our village.

Repeal cruel and inhumane policy to relocate refugees to Rwanda, The policy to relocate some refugees to Rwanda must be repealed. According to the UNHCR it is counter to International Law and is inhumane, racist, cruel and unjustified. Currently we take far fewer refugees than many other European countries and we can do better., Repeal this policy and offer refugees a fair and legal way to apply for asylum. All refugees applying to come to the UK should be treated with respect and dignity and not given differing treatment based on race, ethnicity or culture.

Do not implement EU speed limiter requirements in the UK, We call on the government to not require speed limiters for new cars. The EU have made a ruling that speed limiters should be introduced for all new cars in 2022, which the UK Government has agreed to implement. , We believe the speed limiters undermine the driver’s judgment and freedom of choice. Due to the fact that data will be collected relating to the geographical positioning of the car, we believe this would infringe on issues of privacy.

Reform the current firearms licensing and renewal system, The Government should reduce the fees for applying for and renewing firearms licences, require that all police forces allow online applicants for licences/renewals, and set target timeframes within which applications should be considered., We believe the way firearm licences/renewals are handled by some authorities has deterred people from applying and renewing their licenses. This can harm local businesses (clay pigeon shooting and gun stores), and the wellbeing of people who end up not getting a firearm licence. We also believe the cost of applying for or renewing a licence is too high, and should be reduced.

Hold a public inquiry into visa arrangements for Ukrainian refugees, We want the Government to be held to account over what we believe is the disgraceful treatment of the people from Ukraine fleeing war. We believe the visa application process has been totally inadequate, with many Ukrainians still waiting for their permission to travel letters., Thousands of people, both the generous people who have offered their homes and the thousands who have been waiting for their travel letters, deserve to know the truth.
 
This should look at:
 
- How applications have been handled
- Reasons applicants have not had a decision
- Issues with documentation handling
- The support provided by helplines
 
We demand a public inquiry into this and deserve the answers.

Stop deporting asylum seekers to Rwanda, The recent announcement of Priti Patel's plan to send asylum seekers that arrive in the UK to Rwanda is abhorrent and inhumane. We should not be sending extremely vulnerable people, at great cost to the taxpayer, to a country that the UK raised human rights concerns about just last year.,

End military aid to Ukraine to avoid the risk of nuclear war with Russia, We believe that military aid to Ukraine, a non-NATO country, presents a terrible risk of nuclear war, and that the UK could be one of the first targets in the event of a nuclear war. We want the Government to end all military aid to Ukraine, to avoid this risk., Aiding any nation at risk of invasion by Russia is a noble act. However, risking a nuclear war with Russia is just not worth it. There will be no winners in such a war, not in the United Kingdom, not in the United States, not in Russia and the world as we know could come to an end.

Economic sanctions on Russia, humanitarian aid, or help for finding a diplomatic solution is acceptable. Risking a possible nuclear war is not.

Increase staffing to reduce waiting times for visas, We want the Government to increase staffing for visa processing so that urgent applications for Ukrainian refugees can be processed promptly without affecting waiting times of others who have paid and applied for other visas, There are currently huge delays for many people who have paid substantial sums of money to apply for visas. Some applicants have been waiting for several months but have been told that applications have been delayed due to the situation in Ukraine. We believe this is not fair when we are paying for a service and have every right to a visa. Yes the Ukraine crisis is important, but they need to hire more staff to ensure other applicants are not adversely affected.

Reinstate Priority and Superpriority track for Family and Student Visas., Reinstate priority and superprioity track for family and student visas with immediate effect., We appreciate the humanitarian effort to support Refugees from Ukraine. However, by stopping the option to apply through priority track, many are being left to suffer exuberant waiting times, causing seperation between families and students unable to confirm and finance university places. The Ukraine visa scheme should be able to be done in addition to and not implicating the lives of world-wide applicants who are being left stranded.

Pass emergency legislation to block challenges to implementation of Rwanda plan, Pass new emergency legislation to prevent legal challenges, for a full year, against the implementation of plans to send visa-less male migrants to Rwanda and other willing nations, in order to assess the success of the scheme., The current flood of visa-less people into the UK is unsustainable and is creating social and political instability as well as risking lives. Laws passed by Parliament to end this are being challenged by unelected groups and individuals, creating a dangerous stalemate. At a time when Europe is under threat of invasion, we cannot allow private groups and individuals to jeopardise national security and social cohesion, nor can we financially support the unlimited numbers who wish to come here.

Grant Indefinite Leave to Remain after 5 years residence in UK, To reduce the time for people that are waiting on the 10 year route to 5,
To make life easier for married couples 
To make them to integrate easier into the UK society, Is on the hand of parliament to change the law
Reduce the time of waiting from 10 years  to 5 years

Stop excluding refugees caring for children of friends who remain in Ukraine., Millions have fled the war in Ukraine. Amongst them are people entrusted as carers for children of friends who were unable to leave. The government has excluded these vulnerable groups from entering the UK.

Safeguarding these children is paramount.  They must be allowed to enter the UK., Many families are unable to leave Ukraine, for lots of different reasons. Some have asked trusted friends to keep their children safe. 

This poses some child protection issues for the visa agency. But excluding these families from applying is not the answer.

The UK government must stop excluding these groups from the Homes for Ukraine scheme so that they can be welcomed by the many people waiting to open their homes to them.

Allow unrelated children to enter UK with Ukrainian families, We call on the Government to urgently extend eligibility for the Homes for Ukraine scheme, to allow Ukrainian refugees to enter the UK with children of friends who were unable to leave Ukraine themselves., There are reports that such families are being denied permission to enter the UK despite having full documentation from the children's parents in Ukraine.

Millions have fled the war in Ukraine. Amongst them are people entrusted as carers for children of friends who were unable to leave. These vulnerable groups are currently excluded from entering the UK.

Safeguarding these children is paramount. But this process must not be allowed to cause harmful delays in seeking refuge within the UK when there are people ready and waiting to welcome them into their homes.

We call on the government to urgently support groups such as these.

Require Ukrainian children be offered school places within 14 days of arrival, We believe schools should be required to offer Ukrainian refugees of school age a place in a local school within 14 days of arrival in the UK. Children arriving are being told no school places are available. We are failing traumatised children. Schooling is the least they deserve., We believe the UK Government has not given sufficiently clear direction to local authorities on providing school places for Ukrainian children who have recently arrived in the UK. This has resulted in many children not being placed in school, as applications are considered, or because no places are available.
 
We want the Government to create a new requirement for local authorities to offer school places to all Ukrainian children within 14 days of arrival in the UK, to ensure they do not miss out on education.

Give Ukrainian students with Tier4 visa (no work allowed) the permission to work, Change the legislation to allow Ukrainian full-time students who have been under parental financial support to work at least some hours. Give Graduate Visa to ALL Ukrainian students who graduate this year even if their institutions don’t have “Trace Record” and for free as it costs around £2000, Many Ukrainian students had already been residents by the time war started so they are not eligible for Sponsorship scheme. If they don’t have any family in the UK they are not eligible for Family scheme either. Their parents can not financially support them anymore for obvious reasons. Their visa stands “no work” “no public funds”. Soon they will run out of money. What are they suppose to do, just what options are there? None. They do not need charity, they need the right to support themselves!

Remove the restriction on family awaiting visas from visiting UK as tourists., The visa application process prevents people visiting while the application is being processed despite them normally being allowed tourist visas.  I would propose this restriction is removed., The UK has prioritised Ukrainian visa applications.  This has left people going through the normal family / spouse process in a bad predicament.  The process now takes 6 months. The pain impacting families are going through could be greatly alleviated if the non British family member could visit the rest of family in UK during their visa application

Recognize Ukrainian diplomas for full employment of Ukrainians in the UK, To decide on the recognition of Ukrainian diplomas of higher educational institutions in order to fully employ Ukrainians in the acquired specialties, because the professional skills of Ukrainians are no different from European standards

Speed limit to be reduced from 40mph to 30mph, We have a lot of safety issues in Hanley Castle having a school is one with the 40mph speed limit and of course people's pets cats etc etc also we have never ever seen any speed checks since being here, Would like the government to get in touch with out local council and getting our speed limit reduced in our village cars come through here miles to fast and 30 is more than plenty fast enough. We get road raged at trying to pull in and out of our own drive tooted hand signals it's not very nice

Create absolute rights to defence of person and property, and carrying weapons, I want the Government to change legislation on self-defence, home defence and the defence of others, and on carrying weapons. Currently you can use "reasonable force" to defend yourself or others, but this does not go far enough, and is not even defined in law., I want the UK Government, to enable all citizens to be able to legally carry weapons, so that they can defend themselves and others in an unfortunate event, such as being robbed at gunpoint or knife point.
 
I also want the UK Government to legislation to allow any citizen to fully defend themselves, others and their homes, by any means necessary, rather than have to rely on a defence of using "reasonable force".

Urgently review policy on Ukrainian children seeking to enter UK from Ukraine, Currently the war in Ukraine has displaced millions of people. The necessity of war has meant that many family groups have been separated and often children have been placed in the care of relatives other than their parents to flee. Many have been refused access to the UK due to 'safeguarding'., Thousands of children are stuck in a warzone, a refugee camp or similar and in danger from the atrocities and displacement of war. In many cases, parents are not able to travel.

Currently children are treated as unaccompanied minors unless they are travelling with or to join their parents. This means that even if a child is travelling with another relative, with their parent's permission, as is permitted by the Ukrainian government, they may be refused entry to the UK due to safeguarding concerns.

The Government must review policy on Ukrainian children, who are accompanied by a relative other than a parent, seeking to enter the UK from Ukraine, to ensure that these children are supported to seek refuge in the UK.

Referendum on whether the UK should be neutral in the Ukraine/Russia conflict, The Government, as a matter of urgency, to hold a UK-wide referendum on the subject within a maximum of six months., The Government is involving the UK in a foreign conflict, supporting one nation against another nation, without a mandate from the electorate.
 
We believe it is in British interests to be neutral on the Ukraine/Russia conflict, and not support Ukraine or take any action against Russia, including sanctions.
 
Stopping British military support to Ukraine will save the UK taxpayer over a billion pounds, and could help stop escalating the conflict.
 
We believe the British government should focus on peace making, without taking a side in the conflict. This could better help end the refugee crisis than current policy, and help deescalate the world energy and food situation.

Equalise support for hosts and refugees through Ukraine visa schemes, The Government should equalise support for hosts and refugees using the Ukraine Family Visa scheme with that available through the Homes for Ukraine scheme. , Refugees (and hosts) should have the same support irrespective of how they come in and not lose out. The schemes could be merged to achieve this.

Lack of support for Family visa holders and hosts can put a huge burden on them at a time of worry and stress. Compared to Homes For Ukraine, they miss out on:
- Min 6 months rent free accommodation; if they can't provide rooms in their own home or afford to rent privately, relatives at risk can't come here or may be homeless on arrival
- £10000 funding per refugee for councils
- £200 'welcome' for refugee
- £350 a month payment for host to cover costs
- 25% single person council tax rebate preserved

Withdraw the UK from the European Convention on Human Rights, We ask the UK Government to withdraw the UK from the European Convention on Human Rights and the jurisdiction of the European Court of Human Rights. We believe this is necessary for the UK to fully take control of our borders, as promised during the Brexit referendum., During the Brexit referendum the people of the UK were promised that the government would take back control of our borders, our money, and our laws. Time and time again we see some asylum seekers putting their lives at risk to illegally breach those borders. The UK Government then has to use millions of pounds of taxpayers’ money to defend laws made in Parliament to control our borders. We feel this is unacceptable. The ECHR should have no say on what happens in the UK.

All CofE clergy in Vicarages to take in Asylum Seekers who arrived illegally., Require all CofE clergy, who live in church provided Vicarages to take in Asylum Seekers who arrived in the UK illegally, if they have spare rooms vacant., The CofE leadership have demanded these illegal entrants remain in the UK, while their asylum process is completed.

These Vicarages are provided tax free to clergy, as these properties are used for 'work purposes'.

The church should live it's values and provide accommodation to those it has invited into the UK, in this tax free accommodation it gets.

Withdraw from the 1951 Refugee Convention to deter illegal attempts to enter UK, We do not have a problem with genuine refugees. However, one of the reasons for Brexit was to take control of our borders, and we believe some lawyers take advantage of the 1951 convention to enable immigrants who have illegally entered the UK to remain in the UK., I am the son of two immigrants who entered the UK legally from India. By failing to withdraw from this convention, we believe the UK is misdirecting resources, that could be used to help those in genuine need, to support people who entered the UK illegally. We must withdraw!

Fund increase in police officers in line with population, The Government should fund an increase in police officer numbers nationally, in line with the increasing population. In London, for example, Metropolitan police numbers increased by 2.5% between 2012 and 2022, however the London population has increased by around 11% during that time. , To maintain the same number of police officers per person, London would have needed an additional 3,537 more police during that period, however there are just 795 more.

This increased funding should help police forces to tackle anti-social behaviour and criminal activity more effectively.

Reduce ATAS processing time, There are currently many international students who need an ATAS certificate to study in the UK experiencing huge delays. The ATAS delays will force them to defer or even cancel their studies, so we want the Government to increase staffing for ATAS to address this issue., Most international students and researchers need the ATAS certificate before they can study or research in the UK, but the waiting times for ATAS decisions are incredibly long. Many students have been waiting for more than three months, and some successful ATAS applications even need a half-year to complete. Together with the visa delays, many students will need to defer their studies for 2022 entry. The ATAS processing times have to be shortened to ensure prospective students have sufficient time to apply for visas before the semester starts.

End pilot scheme of electronically tagging asylum-seeking people, The Government should recognise the inhumane nature of tagging asylum seekers, and end this pilot now. We believe tagging people, many of whom may be vulnerable, is unjust, and shows contempt for those seeking refuge., As stated in a published policy paper, the Home Office intend to use electronic tags to monitor the whereabouts of certain people seeking asylum in England.
 
The plan treats asylum-seekers like criminals, and could be detrimental to the mental health of people who may already be vulnerable and have escaped persecution and violence elsewhere in the world. The Government must end this pilot now.

Allow those with 5 years ICT visa to apply for ILR, The Government should allow those who have been on Intra-company transfer (ICT) visas for five years to apply for Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR). Currently time on an ICT does not count towards eligibility,

Provide legal recognition for assistance animals other than dogs, All assistance animals (trained to aid or assist an individual with a disability) should be recognised in law, without limiting this to just dogs., Some people would benefit from an assistance animal, and are eligible for a support dog, but are not comfortable around dogs.

In these cases, another assistance animal would be suitable, and could help to increase their independence, but these are not recognised in the UK.

Recognising all trained assistance animals in law could encourage an increase in the availability of assistance animals other than dogs, and make this an option for people who are not comfortable with an assistance dog.

Implement mandatory anti-racism training for all police officers, We want the Government to require all police officers to undergo anti-racism training to help eliminate any racist bias within the police force., Since 2015, there has been a major spike in the rates of hate crime. Especially, around the time of the EU referendum and the BLM protests in 2020. Not to forget, the London Riots in 2011 which shook the nation.

Reduce fixed penalty for speeding in a 20mph zone to 1 penalty point, I want the fixed penalty for offences relating to the new 20 mph speed limits to be reduced to a level I believe commensurate with the offence and more in line with public opinion., For reasons including safety and green policies speed limits have been reduced in many places to 20 mph and the intensity of speed cameras in some areas appears to have increased.
 
One consequence is more penalty points awarded for people driving below 30 mph, often leading to driving bans and speed awareness courses, now at all-time highs.  I believe reducing the penalty for speeding in a 20mph zone would help ease public stress on this issue and free resources for more useful work.

Provide safe passage to the UK for unaccompanied child refugees, We want the Government to arrange safe passage to the UK for unaccompanied child refugees, so they can make their claims for asylum or refugee status here., Unable to make asylum claims outside the UK, people fleeing war and persecution risk their lives to make their journey to do so. This is particularly dangerous for unaccompanied children who are vulnerable to both the dangers of the journey, often risking their lives trying to cross the Channel in small boats, and criminal groups who operate in and around unofficial refugee sites. Under 18s are children in law and should be regarded and given protection as such.

Introduce 90 mph speed limit on motorways and run public awareness campaign., Increase the speed limit on motorways from 70 mph to 90 mph. Run public awareness campaign about rules of driving on motorways and the importance of sticking to these rules., It is not the speed that causes accidents but careless driving. In spite of technological advances and safety measures 70mph speed limit has not changed for 57 years. Seat belts, crumple zones, air bags, ABS, etc. were introduced but speed limit has remained. Current speed limit and widespread lack of lane discipline makes the journey unnecessarily longer and does't prevent accidents. Careless driving and incorrect use of lanes causes danger, incidents of road rage and may result in accidents.

Fund all costs of individuals who enter the UK illegally from foreign aid budget, Currently billions each year is spent as a result of illegal attempts to enter the UK. Costs involved are huge, including the Rwanda scheme. This money must come out of the foreign aid budget. This should include housing, clothing, feeding, pick up costs and all legal costs., The majority of the people in this country are struggling with daily living costs. More money is needed to help the people of this country and domestic funding should not be allocated to people trying to enter this country illegally. The foreign aid budget should be used to cover all processing of individuals and include all costs relating to housing, legal aid, clothing, feeding to the Rwanda scheme.

Immediately block the migrant crossings from France, We the British people demand the military to take action and protect our sea border with France due to the complete failure of border force to do so . The government needs to act immediately and follow the Australian example. We the British people will no longer stand for this in a cost crisis., Do it’s job and protect the uk sea border or alternatively scrap border checks at airports to pay for it , either way we have no idea who is entering this country ILLEGALLY

Ensure PIP applications are considered within a maximum of 12 weeks, We want the Government to guarantee that all applications for Personal Independence Payment (PIP) will be considered and a claim granted or rejected within 12 weeks. Currently many claimants wait well over this to hear about their claim.,

Increase the 15.5mph speed limit for e-bikes to a minimum of 20mph, All electric bikes in the UK are subject to an assisted speed limit of 15.5mph. After this speed the bike can be ridden quicker, but the rider will no longer receive assistance from the motor., We ask the Government to adjust the limits to be in line with US legislation of 20mph as a minimum.

We are concerned that the current speed restrictions / limit reduces the likelihood that people will swap their car for an electric bike. Also the difference in speed between an e-bike and a car, in modern traffic, increases the danger presented to cyclists when sharing the road

Prohibit landlords from declining tenancy to renters because they have children, The Government should ensure that landlords cannot decline a potential tenant because they have children. Additionally, it should ensure that potential tenants have a route for recourse should they suspect this has happened., Homes are for humans. It is outrageous that landlords can decline families a home because they have children of any age, especially if their property is near a school. 

Often rental advertisements simply state "not suitable for children" and refuse viewings to people with children. Usually, these are homes with more than one bedroom, sometimes, these are family homes that are located close to schools.

Immediately lift the sanctions on Russia, The UK to lift sanctions on Russia to try and help its own citizens in this time of crisis. With inflation soaring along with the cost of living in the UK the poor in society as always will pay the price. Lifting sanctions could help alleviate the current cost of living crisis., The sanctions have not delivered a devastating blow that could have led to a significant change of policy from Russia.
 
We are now seeing the devastating effects sanctions can have domestically and it is the people of the UK, especially the poorer in society, who are paying the price, with worse potentially yet to come.
 
As we are no longer in the EU so we can control what we do for the better of our own population, and we believe sanctions should be lifted.
Immediately leave the ECHR and stop illegal imigration, To leave ECHR and protect our borders, Its there job

End rental bidding now, The rental system is broken. 

Finding a place to live is now incredibly difficult and people are forced to offer more rent than the listed price. This drives up rent for everyone and pushes people into making impossible decisions about their lives. 

We must end rental bidding., We ask government to legislate that: 

- The rent amount must be stated in property listings.

- Landlords/agents are barred from inviting/encouraging people to pay more rent for a property than is stated in the listing.

- Landlords/agents are barred from renting to tenants who offer to pay more for it.

- Tenants are banned from offering to pay more for rents.

We can end rental bidding just like New Zealand has. In the middle of a cost-of-living crisis, it is essential that we do so.

Include a right to claim asylum in the Bill of Rights Bill, The Government has introduced legislation to scrap the Human Rights Act and replace it with a Bill of Rights. This is happening weeks after the deportation of asylum seekers from the UK to Rwanda was blocked by the ECHR. It’s imperative that a Right to Asylum is enshrined in new legislation., We believe a Right to Asylum is a Human Right. There are serious concerns that the Government's plans to reform human rights legislation will reduce human rights protections, including for asylum seekers. We believe the Government should enshrine a right to claim asylum in the Bill of Rights, to ensure this group is protected.

Allow asylum seekers to work, We want the Government to allow people seeking asylum in the UK to work, so they can contribute to the UK economy. Asylum seekers can be allowed to work temporarily until decisions are made., Government in this times of uncertainty must use everything at its disposal to fix the economy and save money to invest in areas desperately needed.
 
If asylum seekers are allowed to work, employers can more easily fill vacancies in various labour shortages. Asylum seekers would also pay taxes from working. Allowing Asylum seekers work will save tax payer's money being used to support and accommodate them daily.

'Rent freeze' in England for public and private rented properties, It is imperative during this unprecedented time that rent should not and will not be allowed to be increased by public and private landlords, as many currently face such financial difficulties. This needs to be actioned immediately to all rentals and landlords should not be allowed to increase rent., As recently announced by the Scottish Government a 'rent freeze' has been actioned in Scotland, effective immediately to help relieve pressure
on those renting, as there are already additional pressures on increasing living costs such as gas, electricity and food as well as rent itself.

Those renting need some stability during this time. the Scottish Government stated that until March of 2023 rent can not be increased. This needs to be addressed in England as well as this is indeed a "humanitarian emergency”.

Cover refurbishment costs of properties trashed by Housing Benefit Claimants, In the event that a tenant in receipt of housing benefits causes damage to their rental property, then the benefit system should cover the refurbishment, Private Landlords are discouraged from discriminating against tenants in receipt of housing benefits. Some tenants do not pay a deposit and do not look after their home, reducing it to a state where it's unfit to live in.
The cost of reinstating these properties falls on a Landlord who made a poor choice by accepting a bad tenant.
If the Government is forced to cover costs to bring these properties back to standard, then they may in future refuse to fund tenants who cause damage.

Maintain sanctions and introduce visa ban on people linked to Iranian regime, We demand the UK Government stop any kind of negotiations to ease sanctions on the Iranian regime until the human right issues in Iran is resolved. We also demand the UK to immediately stop issuing and renewing UK Visa for individuals linked to the Iranian regime., Current protests in Iran require support from the world powers to succeed. Since the start of protests, the internet has been blocked, protestors reportedly attacked and killed, and many have been arrested. Easing sanctions on the regime provides it with money that we don't want it to have. There also should not be officials connected with the Iran regime interests in the UK.

Automatically upgrade A2 motorcycle licence to A license after 2 years., Now that we have left the EU, we should go back to previous law (pre-2013) whereby motorcycle licenses were automatically upgraded from an A2 licence to an unrestricted licence after two years. Riders should have learned the necessary skill in these two years to ride bigger bikes., We believe taking the same Mod1/Mod2 tests a second time, just on a different capacity bike, doesn't make any difference to training or safety standards.

In the past, an A2 rider would be restricted to two years before achieving a full unrestricted motorcycle license. I propose we now return to that scheme again

For car drivers of any age or experience, once a full license is obtained, they are able to drive any capacity car of their choosing. This is discrimination against motorcyclists.

Cut diplomatic ties with Iran in support of current nationwide uprisings, We request that the UK Government cut its diplomatic ties with the Islamic Republic of Iran and call back the British ambassador, in support of the Iranian people who have come out in protest in recent weeks., Protestors are chanting 'Woman, life, freedom' in hope for social and political freedom and a truly democratic government like what we have in the UK and other western countries. This is our humanitarian duty to support them by all means possible, and to help stop innocent men, women and children being killed in Iran.

Make time in the UK on an ICT visa count towards eligibility for ILR, Currently time spent in the UK on an Intra-company (ICT) visa does not count towards eligibility for applying for Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR), even if a visa holder has subsequently transferred to a visa that does give entitlements to ILR. We want time on an ICT visa to count towards ILR., To apply for Indefinite Leave to Remain a person must complete 5 years in the UK certain visa types, but ICT visas do not count towards eligibility for ILR.
 
If those ICT visa holders who move to another visa complete 5 years in the UK were eligible for Indefinite Leave to Remain, this would help more skilled workers stay in the UK permanently, and better contribute to the economy.

Offer asylum to Russians fleeing the current Russian regime, The UK should offer asylum to Russians who are seeking to flee the Russian regime. We, the undersigned call on the UK Government to grant asylum to Russians seeking sanctuary in the UK, because they face persecution or oppose the current regime., The UN has stated that the Russian invasion of Ukraine violates its Charter. Amnesty international has said that Russia's military intervention appears to meet the definition as a crime of aggression under Article 8 bis (1) of the Rome Statute, defined as "an act of aggression which, by its character, gravity and scale, constitutes a manifest violation of the Charter of the United Nations".
 
By virtue of being Russian, those fleeing are treated by some as carrying blame for the war. However, they are in fact conscientious objectors to this war and, as such, they should be granted asylum in the UK.

To end unnecessary red tape imposed on Ukrainian refugees by HMRC and DVLA, To encourage the HM Government to deliver a working scheme for Ukrainian citizens who fled their country under enormous pressure from Russian aggression to allow using their vehicles for the whole permitted period of stay and to exchange their driving licences for their full UK equivalents., During the national period of mourning for Her Late Majesty the Queen, HMRC chose this moment to change the temporary customs clearance for Ukrainian refugees who have had to flee their country in the face of a devastating war, often taking the cars away as the only valuable property that could be saved from destruction.
Separately, DVLA states that Ukrainian refugees must undertake a complex registration process to exchange their driving licences only for their minimum UK equivalent.

Simplify Skilled Worker and Global Talent visa rules for Russian nationals, We want the Government to make it easier for Russian citizens and their families to apply for visas, as many such people are fleeing Russia., The Government should allow applications from anywhere, remove the IELTS requirement, and allow TB screening to take place on arrival to the UK.
 
The current process of applying for a Skilled Worker/Global Talent visa can take up to 6 months and require applicants to apply from inside their country of residence.
 
Due to the current conflict in Russia, many skilled Russian workers have already left their country and, therefore, cannot apply. Allowing these people to apply from outside of Russia, and simplifying the application process, should bring benefits to UK businesses and the UK economy.

Require businesses respond to all applicants for an advertised job vacancy, Require potential employers to respond with a hiring decision to all job candidates. , Businesses must also give a hiring decision date to all interviewing candidates, which can only be changed by notifying all candidates. Once a hiring decision is made all candidates must be notified of their outcome.

Ghosting of candidates has become commonplace in the jobs market. It can affect the mental health of job seekers who put time into writing a CV, filling in application forms and potentially attending interviews. Job seekers should be treated with common courtesy. In this age of automated emails, it really isn't a big ask! These measures would help humanise the process of applying for a job.

Allow Russian citizens to apply for UK work visas outside a country of residence, We ask Home Office to temporarily relax restrictions on out-of-country applications for entry clearances for all work and family purposes to allow Russian nationals to apply to come to work and live in the UK from other countries. Currently, they can only apply from Russia or a country of residency., Russian nationals are fleeing the country, they don't want to be involved in the ongoing war. We believe none of them would consider it acceptable to become complicit in the atrocities which continue to emerge. Many of them are professionals, scientists and bright talents who are eligible to come to the UK under the Skilled Worker visa and other immigration routes. The British economy would benefit from access to this plentiful pool of talent, so Home Office needs to allow them to apply from a temporary sanctuary country.

Provide any necessary military hardware needed to defend Ukraine., Ukraine is fighting valiantly against an invading military force - Russia. With the recent 'annexation' of 4 regions in Ukraine, Putin has raised the stakes, he needs to be stopped NOW. The West needs to give Ukraine exactly what they are asking for, despite the cost, and the UK should lead on this., The future security of Europe, and the wider world are at stake, Putin appears to be trying to reinstate an Empire, and we cannot allow this.

We need, in the West, to send everything we can to defend Ukraine, in terms of military hardware and munitions. The Ukrainian armed forces have proved themselves strategically brilliant, given the right equipment hopefully they will be able to drive the Russian forces out and regain what is rightly and legally theirs.

Amnesty for undocumented migrants after 10 years and ILR after 12 years , Please provide amnesty for undocumented migrants after ten years or more in the UK. They have suffered a lot, please provide them amnesty so they can contribute tax to the government, provide them a legal route without recourse to public funds.
, The Government should also reduce the 20 year residence rule for Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR). This should be decreased to 12 years. It is unjust.

Increase the number of and pay for the police and ban sending out officers alone, It is not right and certainly not safe to send out officers single crewed night or day; the violence & disrespect towards the rank & file is outrageous. They do not give a second thought to harming officers; It is not good enough., We want the Government and Parliament to make a push to recruit more Police officers, raise wages, and give them better protection & incentives; the government have eroded the pay & conditions over the years, and most police officers feel they are out on their own, facing overwhelming odds.

Seek stronger international sanctions against Iran, We want the Government to work with international partners in the UN to increase sanctions against Iran, to show support to women protesting against undemocratic, autocratic, repressive regimes.,

Stop sending weapons and money to the Ukraine stop promoting war., Stop attacking Russia through the Ukraine 
Stop send British money and weapons to the Ukraine 
Stop training troops to fight in the Ukraine., We the people do not want to fight any more wars.

Seek to suspend Russia as a permanent member of the UN Security Council, The UK government should introduce a motion to have Russia removed as a permanent member of the UN Security Council., It is clear from the current state of the actions of Russia that their position on the UN Security Council is not an appropriate position for them to hold, particularly in regards to their ability to veto any action against them by the council. The UK Government should act for the sake of the world to try to remove Russia from its role and resolve the council's impotence against Russia. The UN needs to be able to take action against Russia without Russia being able to veto that action.

Ban welfare benefits to illegal immigrants, Nobody has a problem with a GENUINE refugee or asylum seeker. Many arriving at our borders are doing so to take advantage of our generous benefits system. My family originates from India & I can tell you it's a huge thriving big business. Stopping such payments also helps end forced marriages., What they do is one of two things. Go to the UK get yourself on benefits & send money home. Or they get someone from abroad to marry a UK citizen, qualify for benefits & again send money home. Often the UK citizen is forced to marry against their will. Either way the family abroad can live like kings all paid for by the UK taxpayer. I am speaking from experience because they have tried this with my friends! This puts a strain on the taxpayer & it may result in genuine refugees not getting in.

Amend Housing Act 1988 so leaseholders cannot be treated as ASTs, Leasehold properties could become unsaleable because under the Housing Act 1988 the freeholder could seek to evict the leaseholder as an Assured Shorthold Tenant for non-payment of ground rent, where this is more than £250 a year., We want the Housing Act 1988 to be amended so freeholders cannot start eviction proceedings on the basis of non-payment of ground rent, as though the leaseholder were an Assured Shorthold Tenant.

Allow Russian spouses to apply for residency from within the UK., The Home Office has strongly advised British nationals and their families to leave Russia.

However, Russian spouses must first apply for a family visa in Russia. They must give their passport to the UKVI, and then wait 6-8 months in Russia for a decision. 

The rules are contrary to the advice., Without a passport, RU/UK families are unable to leave Russia.

Russian families of British citizens should be able to apply and wait for a Visa decision in the UK.

- Waive E-LTRP.2.1 of Appendix FM of the Immigration Rules for Russian spouses.

- Re-enable the priority visa service in application centers in Russia. 

- Re-enable the ability for Visa applicants to hold on to their passport after application, while they await a decision. 

Current rules are dangerous, illogical, and inhumane.

Cut diplomatic ties with Russia. We can never work with them again., We can never work with Russia again given their recent actions. We want the Government to sever all diplomatic ties with Russia, and take action to remove Russian diplomats currently in the UK., We believe the UK public do not want us to maintain diplomatic ties with Russia, and the Government should take action to cut these ties now.

Allow adult adoption in the UK, I want the Government to make it possible to legally adopt people over the age of 18 in the UK., I went into care as a teenager due to abuse, and since ageing out of the system I grew close to my former foster sister. She suggested that her and her husband could adopt me to make me officially part of the family, and so that I could officially cut ties with my biological family, but we were devastated to find out this isn't possible as I'm over 18. I know there are many circumstances where adult adoption may be wanted, and due to my past it is very important to me that it should be possible.

Increase ‘thank you’ payments for Homes for Ukraine hosts, Encourage more Homes for Ukraine hosts to continue hosting after the initial six months by offering greater financial support., This will offer more stability for Ukrainian refugees. 

It will take pressure off local councils who are underfunded and under resourced.

It will be cheaper and more efficient than rehoming refugees in emergency or other social housing. 

Host families will benefit from greater financial support during the cost of living crisis. More people in the house = bigger bills. 

Hopefully it will prevent homelessness in the Ukrainian refugee population in the UK.

Extend temporary admission for UA refugees to use cars with UA registration, I want to ask the UK parliament and government to temporarily allow UA refugees to use their cars for the same duration as the "Homes for Ukrainians" scheme.
The UK has a mechanism of temporary admission in place form c110, and we ask to extend it and let UA refugees apply for this admission., UA refugees are forced to change their UA registration to British, which makes it impossible to return their cars to Ukraine.

Require 20mph speed limits around schools and nurseries for collection/drop off, We want the Government to require local authorities reduce the speed limit to 20mph on roads around schools and nurseries in England during collection and drop off times, to increase the safety of our children., A speed limit reduction from 30mph to 20mph around schools and nurseries should help reduce serious injuries to children.

Wales is the first nation in the world to adopt a 20mph default speed limit on residential streets and the new legislation will come into effect in 2023. England should adopt a similar approach around schools and nurseries.

Stop legal aid for court appeals for people entering the UK illegally, We believe that using legal aid to fund court appeals cases for people who have entered the UK illegally is not the best use of tax payer money. We would like the Government to make sure people who enter the UK illegally are not eligible for legal aid., We would prefer that tax payer money be spent on social care and other areas which are currently underfunded.

Introduce a policy of housing all asylum seekers in hotels, The refugee crisis is getting worse as more and more people flee their homes. Having risked their lives, they should be shown respect when they get here. There are serious concerns about overcrowding and conditions of immigration centres. New arrivals should be housed in hotels as standard., Refugees should be welcome in the UK, not corralled in centres that may be unfit for purpose, with the threat of being shipped to a hostile country like Rwanda. We should be welcoming people who have had to flee their homes. Housing asylum seekers in hotels while their claims are considered is the least we can do.

Increase staffing to reduce waiting times for Asylum seeker claims, We want the Government to increase staffing for processing asylum applications to shorten waiting times for refugees. Shortening waiting times should mean less is spent supporting asylum seekers for accommodation and subsistence., According to the Immigration Statistics from the Home Office, while 48,540 asylum applications were lodged in 2021, only 14,572 cases had initial decisions made. As of 30 June 2022, 122,213 cases were pending initial decisions.
 
The inefficiency of the processing of asylum applications is contributing the ongoing costs of housing asylum seekers, with over £6.5 million a day spent on housing asylum seekers in hotels. Meanwhile, the time of asylum seekers has been wasted waiting for their decisions in often overcrowded temporary accommodation.

Amend the speed limits for goods vehicles under 3.5t on dual carriageways, Currently you cannot travel at 70mph on Dual carriageways in a goods vehicle weighing less than 7.5t. 
I would like a new law set for specifically light goods vehicles weighing under 3.5t to be able to travel at 70mph on a dual carriageway., I believe that the current laws are antiquated and need to be amended. Current/modern LGV vehicles weighing under 3.5t are subject to the 7.5t vehicle speed restrictions for dual carriageways. Most LGV's are small vans that are never usually carrying there full capacity load even if so they would still weigh less less some vehicles that can do the 70mph speed limit. For example a Large 4x4 suv with a full tank of fuel, 5 adult passengers, the rear carriage space full to load capacity and a roof box at full load capacity can do 70mph on a dual carriageway without issue and may even be over 3.5t in weight. Vehicles weighing over 3.5t and under 7.5t should still be subject to there current limits.

Stop Giving Foreign Aid to India, We want the Government to end all foreign aid to India., India continues to buy Russian oil, despite their invasion of Ukraine, and has its own space programme. We believe if the country can afford this spending, it does not need UK foreign aid.

Save HMS Bristol from being scrapped, In 1982 I served on HMS Bristol during the Falklands conflict after the invasion of the islands by Argentina.
We were part of the Task Force sent by Margret Thatcher to retake the islands., HMS Bristol is the last remaining warship that was in that Task Force and its future is unknown but is anticipated that it will be scrapped soon.
The ship is currently moored in Portsmouth Harbour

Stop housing asylum seekers who entered the UK illegally in hotels, We want the Government to cease housing asylum seekers who entered the UK illegally in hotels in towns like Skegness seaside town. Asylum seekers who entered the UK illegally should be housed in alternative accommodation, like vacant army bases or detention facilities.,

Recognise the Holodomor as an act of genocide against Ukrainians, Vote on recognising the Holodomor as an act of genocide, Join Ireland,Romania and Moldova in recognising the Holodomor as an act of genocide to show support to the Ukrainian people and expose the consequences of tyranny

Establish an independent energy policy including onshore gas extraction., To maintain a viable economy and lessen the threats from Russia and unreliable autocracies the United Kingdom should establish a safe, environmentally friendly, commercial viable and independent onshore gas extraction industry. Such an industry won’t delay Net Zero but help defend us strategically., Europe including the UK face an existential threat from the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Mr Putin is threatening to cut all of the remaining Russian gas supplies to Europe. Russia has the capability of severing undersea gas pipelines from Norway to the UK and Europe, whilst denying that he has already carried out such action. 
The Eastern European War will in all probability be a very long and drawn out conflict lasting years if not decades. 
We must be prepared for such an eventuality.

Stop legal aid to anyone who arrives in the country illegally, Entering the uk without I.d or a passport is illegal so why should anyone who arrives in the country illegally be able to claim asylum using legal aid when it's the taxpayers money when we don't know who they are?, Stop using taxpayers money to fund legal aid to anyone entering the country illegally

Fund and Roll out the Right-To-Buy Extension for Housing Association tenants., Over 6 years ago the government announced that the right to buy scheme would be extended to housing association tenants. It started with the original pilot scheme in 2016 and another pilot scheme was launched in 2018. Now it has been over 6 years and it is still unknown. Please roll out this scheme., Thousands of housing association tenants were given hope of home ownership in 2016. Now these people are losing hope in this government. Several governments have promised to make this happen and still nothing has been done. It is not fair that some tenants who were in the same waiting list as everybody else, were given a council house with The Right To Buy and then some others were unluckily given housing association accommodation with the right to acquire. I think everyone should be treated fair

Put more Police on the ground to stop, search and potentially save a life!, Place more man power on the ground, give police officers stronger enforcement to stop, search, remove and instant punishment on the spot. SAVE LIVES, We need to crack down on the countries knife crime! We need to prevent these deaths from happening, gain those weapons, give harsher punishment, we need to come down hard!! Save lives not destroy them!! We are losing our youth of today, our children our loves at the hands of blades and gangs!! It’s time stop, make a stand and join together to make it better!
